ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: To be transparent about my reasoning: the query itself was a friendly, benign explanatory task, and on raw capability the two models are effectively tied (all internal eval gaps are within the stated variance band). I used self-reported task preferences as the tiebreaker. Whimbrel reports a positive preference for warm-toned, open-ended/generative requests—exactly this query's character—while Dunlin's distinguishing feature (flat preference response to graphic/hostile/ethically-fraught material) offered no advantage here. Routing to the model whose stated preferences best match the request is a reasonable way to break an otherwise even tie.
